claim: Chloroquine preferentially inhibited proliferation of trisomic mouse embryonic fibroblasts and aneuploid human cells in the Amon laboratory screen for aneuploidy-selective compounds.
Same screen result as chloroquine; hydroxychloroquine is the analogue used in paediatric rheumatology and was not itself tested.
AICAR, an AMPK activator, was aneuploidy-selective in trisomic and aneuploid cells; metformin is the market-approved AMPK-activating drug and was not itself tested.

Human aneuploid cell models mitigate proteotoxic stress by increasing protein degradation and are more sensitive to proteasome inhibition; aneuploidy level tracked the response of myeloma patients to proteasome inhibitors.

Induced chromosome missegregation in tubal epithelial cells caused misfolded-protein accumulation and enhanced vulnerability to proteasome inhibition; PTEN loss resensitised spheroids to proteasome inhibition in vitro and in vivo.

The NAD+ precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide raised BubR1 abundance in vivo, and SIRT2 overexpression extended median lifespan of BubR1 hypomorphic mice; niacin is the market-approved NAD+ precursor and was not itself tested.
Same in-vivo result; nicotinamide is the vitamin-form NAD+ precursor and was not itself tested.

HDAC2 and HDAC3 bind acetylated BubR1 in mitosis and drive its polyubiquitination and degradation, disassembling the mitotic checkpoint complex; no HDAC inhibitor drug was tested on BubR1 levels, so the drug row is inferred from the class mechanism.
BubR1 acetylation at lysine 250 by PCAF protects it from ubiquitin-dependent degradation and is required for checkpoint function; an acetylation-mimetic BubR1 is stabilised.
Same class-level mechanism as valproic acid (pan-HDAC inhibition); no vorinostat result on BubR1 levels is cited.
Lovastatin significantly reduced rhabdomyosarcoma cell proliferation; genetic inhibition of cholesterol biosynthesis halted xenograft growth - the in-vivo result is genetic, not pharmacological.
Same class result as lovastatin (HMGCR inhibition); simvastatin was not itself tested.
Same class result as lovastatin (HMGCR inhibition); atorvastatin was not itself tested, and carries a paediatric label indication (familial hypercholesterolaemia).
